name: Hyousetsu no Hanataba
source:
Several hundred years ago, in an age when witches still existed, the great witch Yuki comes to a human village to gather supplies and meets a young girl in front of the church. Little by little, the girl's innocent smile melts Yuki's heart. Their meeting marks the beginning of a story that will span centuries.

An unofficial fan-made game based on [url=/v50283]Mahou Shoujo no Majo Saiban[/url], telling a (fan-invented) story of Meruru and Yuki's past. Contains heavy spoilers for the original game.

[From BOOTH, translated]
translation:
数百年前，在魔女尚存于世的时代，大魔女雪为了采购物资来到一座人类村落，在教堂前邂逅了一名年幼的少女。少女纯真无邪的笑容，一点点融化了雪冰封的心扉。她们二人的相遇，揭开了一段跨越数个世纪的漫长物语。

本作是基于[url=/v50283]《魔法少女的魔女审判》[/url]创作的非官方同人游戏，讲述了（粉丝二次创作的）梅露露与雪的过往故事。内含原作游戏的重大剧透。

[译自BOOTH]
